item.command: /bin/bash -lc 'site_dir=$(mktemp -d "$TMPDIR/hbtu-official-XXXXXX"); urls='"'https://hbtu.ac.in/ https://hbtu.ac.in/about-us/ https://hbtu.ac.in/address/ https://hbtu.ac.in/programmes/ https://hbtu.ac.in/bachelors-admissions/ https://hbtu.ac.in/masters-programmes/ https://hbtu.ac.in/ph-d-programmes/ https://hbtu.ac.in/mandatory-disclosure/ https://hbtu.ac.in/public-self-disclosure/'; n=0; for url in "'$urls; do n=$((n+1)); name=$(printf '"'%s' \""'$url" | sed -E '"'s#https?://["'^/]+/##; s#[''^A-Za-z0-9]+#_#g; s#_$##'"'); test -n \""'$name" || name=home; curl --insecure --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 -fsSL -A '"'Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/124 Safari/537.36' -H 'Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml' \""'$url" -o "$site_dir/${n}_${name}.html" && printf '"'%s %s\\n' \""'$url" "$site_dir/${n}_${name}.html" || printf '"'FAILED %s\\n' \""'$url"; done; printf '"'DIR=%s\\n' \""'$site_dir"; for f in "$site_dir"/*.html; do printf '"'\\n===%s===\\n' \""'$f"; rg -o '"'<title["'^>]*>[''^<]+'"' \""'$f" | sed -n '"'1p'; rg -i -o '.{0,120}(programme|program|admission|course|degree|Kanpur|Nawabganj|Uttar Pradesh).{0,240}' \""'$f" | sed -n '"'1,80p'; done"

0023: Appointment, Responsibilities and Powers as per HBTU Act 2016
0024: The Dean of Incubation Hub shall be nominated by the Vice Chancellor, from amongst the Professors of the University. The emoluments, terms and conditions of service and powers and duties shall be such as may be laid down in the Ordinances. He shall work directly under the control of the Vice-Chancellor.
0025: He shall hold office for a term of two years and may be eligible for reappointment for one consecutive term.
0026: He shall be responsible for; (a) Industry-University Interaction; (b) management of Incubation Hub.
0027: He shall be also responsible for general administration of Incubation Hub set up for budding entrepreneurs, students, teachers, and engineers, and competent technical persons from society selected with the approval of Executive Council. The University shall also provide support to them to generate equitable venture capital to establish a new industry based on products and processes developed in-house.
0028: He shall recommend to the Executive Council, attachments of the teachers to the relevant industry from engineering/ technology/management disciplines once in three years, for a maximum period of 30 days during summer vacations, clubbed with Summer Training of students of concerned branch.

0000: Personality Development Programme
0001: Welcome to Our Personality Development Programme
0002: In today’s fast-paced and competitive world, possessing a strong and dynamic personality is no longer optional—it’s essential. Whether you’re a student embarking on your academic journey or a professional navigating the complexities of your career, our Personality Development Programme is designed to help you unlock your full potential and achieve unparalleled success.
0003: Why Personality Development Matters
0004: Personal Life:
0005: Your personality is the foundation of your identity. It influences how you interact with others, manage stress, and make decisions. A well-rounded personality helps you build meaningful relationships, fosters self-confidence, and enhances your overall quality of life. By understanding and developing your unique traits, you can create a more fulfilling and balanced personal life.
0006: Professional Life:
0007: In the professional realm, your personality can be your greatest asset. Employers and colleagues are naturally drawn to individuals who exhibit strong communication skills, emotional intelligence, and leadership qualities. A positive and impactful personality can open doors to career advancements, networking opportunities, and leadership roles. It’s a critical factor that sets you apart in the workplace, driving you towards your professional goals.
0008: The Path to Success
0009: Success is often attracted to those who exhibit the best personality traits. Our programme is meticulously crafted to help you cultivate these traits, ensuring that you stand out in both your personal and professional life. Through a series of interactive sessions, practical exercises, and expert guidance, you will learn to:
0010: Enhance Communication Skills:
0011: Master the art of effective communication to express yourself clearly and confidently in any situation.
0012: Build Self-Confidence:
0013: Develop a strong sense of self-worth and the courage to take on new challenges.
0014: Improve Emotional Intelligence:
0015: Understand and manage your emotions, and empathize with others to build stronger relationships.
0016: Develop Leadership Qualities:
0017: Cultivate the ability to inspire, motivate, and lead others towards common goals.
0018: Strengthen Problem-Solving Skills:
0019: Learn to approach problems with a positive mindset and find innovative solutions.
0020: Join us on this transformative journey and discover how a well-developed personality can be the key to unlocking your success. Whether you’re aiming for academic excellence or professional achievements, our Personality Development Programme will equip you with the tools and insights needed to thrive in every aspect of your life.

This course challenges that paradigm, encouraging you to harness your potential to build something of your own. Understanding the dynamics of business is not an insurmountable challenge; it’s an attainable goal that can open doors to financial independence and personal fulfillment.

Whether you’re a student eager to start early or a professional looking to pivot or enhance your career, this course provides a comprehensive and easy-to-follow curriculum. ### /Users/d111879/Documents/Project/DEMO/Student/Student_mobile/sapp/research/agent_runs/uttar-pradesh-wave-01/workspaces/harcourt-butler-technical-university/tmp/hbtu-official-omVpNg/2_about_us.html
0000: About University
0013: Harcourt Butler Technical University (Formerly Harcourt Butler Technological Institute, Kanpur) has always been a paragon and a source of inspiration in the field of science and technology since the year 1921. Now, as per Act No. 11 of 2016 by the government of Uttar Pradesh it is upgraded to University, i.e, Harcourt Butler Technical University, Kanpur (HBTU, Kanpur). The University has been established with a view for making it a leading Residential University w.e.f 01.09.2016 to become a “Centre of Excellence” with focus on Research and Development and Incubation in the field of Engineering, Technology, Basic & Applied Sciences, Humanities, Social Science & Management and other professional courses. HBTU, Kanpur aims to promote studies, research & innovation in engineering areas of higher education, to enhance skill development through continuing education programme and to achieve excellence in higher technical education.
0014: On academic front, the University is running four schools namely, School of Engineering (SoE); School of Chemical Technology (SoCT); School of Basic & Applied Sciences (SoBAS) and School of Humanities and Social Sciences (SoHSS). The University offers thirteen Undergraduate Programmes (B.Tech.) in Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, Leather Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering, Food Technology, Oil Technology, Paint Technology and Plastic Technology and one undergraduate programme in Bachelors of Business Administration (BBA) programme. It also offers M.Tech. programmes in eleven specializations. In addition, it runs a regular Master of Computer Application (M.C.A), Master of Business Administration (MBA), Master of Science (M.Sc.) in three streams (Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics). The University also offers doctoral programme in all the departments. Four departments of the University namely, Civil, Mechanical, Electronics and Chemical Engineering are recognized Quality Improvement Program (QIP) Centres for Ph.D. programmes.
0015: The University provides a congenial environment for the holistic growth and all round development of the students such that they become globally acceptable personalities with communication skills, aptitude, problem solving capabilities and to work as a team.
0016: HBTU Kanpur has received aid from the World Bank (Phases TEQIP-I, TEQIP-II & TEQIP-III) for various developmental projects. This aid has been utilized for development of the infrastructure, new laboratory equipments, maintenance and modernization of old laboratory equipments etc.
0018: It all started in 1920 with the establishment of the Government Research Institute, Cawnpore (Kanpur) by the efforts and great determination of Sir Spencer Harcourt Butler, the then Governor of United Provinces (present Uttar Pradesh). Next year, Institute was renamed as Government Technical Institute and its foundation stone was laid on November 25, 1921. Later on, Institute was given its all famous name – Harcourt Butler Technological Institute (HBTI) in 1926. The onwards march continued with vigour and HBTI since 1921, has always been a paragon and a source of inspiration in the field of science and technology. It has maintained its conspicuous presence in the technical world. HBTI has a history of realization and fulfilment of necessities and advancement as per current needs. It is dedicated to the cause of rapid industrial development, creating a healthy environment for applied researches and, above all, to carve out men and women, having a truly rational and scientific demeanour. ‘Attitude’ is the watchword – taking care of which, the personality of every harcourtian is moulded. Its roots are as deep as its outlook. We built a legacy over a period of time and autonomous status was granted to HBTI in 1965. Our great heritage and traditions with long years of continuous efforts brought us in a community of a selected few technical institutes of India. Government of Uttar Pradesh, by Act No. 11 of 2016, upgraded us to Harcourt Butler Technical University, Kanpur on September 01, 2016 with the mandate to be a leading Residential University and to become a Centre of Excellence with focus on research and development in the field of engineering, technology, science, humanities, management etc.
0019: The University is spread across two campuses – the East Campus (77 acres) and the West Campus (251.8 acres) which are situated about 3 km apart in the very heart of Kanpur. We completed glorious 100 years on November 25, 2021 and the Centenary Celebration function was attended by the Hon’ble President of India.
0020: VIEW/DOWNLOAD HISTORY BOOK OF HBTU, KANPUR
0022: Vision statement clarifies the values, beliefs, and governing principles of the organization. In order to achieve the goal to become center of excellence with focus on Research & Development, Incubation in the fields of Engineering, Technology, Basic and Applied Science, Humanities, Social Science & Management and other professional courses and Innovation in emerging areas of higher technical education, HBTU, Kanpur specified its Vision which is as follows:-
0025: The mission statements of the University are aligned to the vision and they communicate the purpose of the University to all its stakeholders, develop the measurable goals and objectives in order to gauge the success of University’s strategic plan. The Mission statements are as follows:-
0030: Strategic Plan Of HBTU Kanpur
0041: View MBA Ordinance applicable for 2021-22
0043: View MCA Ordinance applicable for 2020-21
0045: VIEW ORDINANCES FOR DOCTOR OF PHILOSOPHY PROGRAMMES
0050: VIEW ORDINANCES FOR DOCTOR OF PHILOSOPHY PROGRAMMES
0067: Policy for the Post-Doctoral fellowship program

0091: Among the magnificient structure of the “Shatabadi Bhavan” and “Shatabadi Stambh” commemorating the “Eternal Legacy” of excellence in Technical Education, Harcourt Butler Technical University, Kanpur (HBTU, Kanpur) celebrated its 100 years of establishment on 25th November, 2021 in the benign presence of Hon’ble President of India along with Hon’ble Chancellor and Governor of Uttar Pradesh, Hon’ble Minister, Technical Education wherein, the University released the Coffee table book & history book, Grounding of Time Capsule in Shatabadi Stambh (approximately 10 m below the ground level), Shatabadi postage stamp and Shatabadi coin etc.
0093: Harcourt Butler Technical University celebrated Centenary Year (1921-2021)
0094: As part of the University’s centenary celebrations, we showcased ‘Our 100’ – 100 things that define our past, present, and future.
0095: Since 1921 Harcourt Butler Technical University (Formerly HBTI Kanpur) has always been a paragon and a source of inspiration in the field of science and technology. It has maintained its conspicuous presence in the technical world. H.B.T.I. has a history of realization, fulfilment of necessities and advancement in the field of science and technology. It is dedicated for the cause of rapid industrial development, creating a healthy environment for applied researches and above all to carve out men and women, having a truly rational and scientific demeanour. ‘Attitude’ is the watchword – taking care of which the personality of every Harcourtian is moulded. Its roots are as deep as its outlook. “Government Research Institute, Cawnpore” was established in 1920, which was renamed as “Government Technological Institute” in 1921. Finally in 1926 it got the name by which we know it today “Harcourt Butler Technological Institute”. Now as per Act No. 11 of 2016 by the Government of Uttar Pradesh it become university, i.e., Harcourt Butler Technical University Kanpur.
0096: Proclaiming the motto of ‘Work is Great Austerity’ as our action in words, this organization keeps adding human resources to achieve excellence in technical education, research and innovation. The University has a rich legacy, tradition and glorious past which propelled it to become of the prestigious institutions of Northern India. It has a strong alumni base spread across the globe who are carrying forward its legacy and culture in their respective fields. Our cherished ritual that give us strength is the blend of theoretical, practical and behavioral aspects of technical education, excellence in research, positive changes and brilliance in every walk and thought.

### department_of_biotechnology.html
0001: Programmes
0017: Department of Biotechnology : Profile
0018: Biotechnology is a multidisciplinary field with immense potential for advancing human welfare, particularly in areas such as human and animal health, food and nutrition, agriculture, animal sciences, environmental science, and more. It has emerged as a key area of focus in science and technology, with the capability to significantly contribute to the economic growth of India and World.
0019: In the 21st century, the global vision for biotechnology emphasizes the transition of bio-based innovations “from Lab to Land and from Bench to Business”, ensuring that the benefits of biotechnological advancements reach society at large by making bio-based products more accessible and affordable.
0020: In alignment with this vision, the Department of Biotechnology was established in 2024, offering a B. Tech in Biotechnology. The department also offer two postgraduate programs: M.Sc. in Biotechnology, M.Sc. in Biochemistry, and Ph.D. in Biotechnology from the Academic Year 2025-2026.
0021: These programs focus on integrated approaches to critical areas such as human health, biopolymers, recombinant DNA technology, transgenic development, infection and immunity etc. A key highlight of the curriculum is the emphasis on hands-on learning, students engage directly with faculty on real-time research projects, equipping them with the practical skills required to address emerging global challenges.

### department_of_pharmaceutical_science.html
0001: Programmes
0016: The Department of Pharmaceutical Sciences was established in 2024 under the School of Pharmaceutical and Biological Sciences with the objective of delivering high-quality education and research in the field of pharmacy. The department commenced its Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) program in the academic year 2024–2025, approved from the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI), New Delhi. It is well equipped with modern laboratories, well-furnished classrooms, and seminar halls to facilitate an effective teaching–learning environment.
0017: The department is dedicated to academic excellence and the promotion of advanced research across multiple pharmaceutical domains. It provides extensive training in patient counseling, drug information services, medication reconciliation, health screening, community outreach programs, health awareness initiatives, medical camps, industrial training, and educational tours.

0015: Department of Pharmaceutical Sciences : Profile
0016: The Department of Pharmaceutical Sciences was established in 2024 under the School of Pharmaceutical and Biological Sciences with the objective of delivering high-quality education and research in the field of pharmacy. The department commenced its Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) program in the academic year 2024–2025, approved from the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI), New Delhi. It is well equipped with modern laboratories, well-furnished classrooms, and seminar halls to facilitate an effective teaching–learning environment.
0017: The department is dedicated to academic excellence and the promotion of advanced research across multiple pharmaceutical domains. It provides extensive training in patient counseling, drug information services, medication reconciliation, health screening, community outreach programs, health awareness initiatives, medical camps, industrial training, and educational tours.
0018: The laboratories are equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure to support academic learning and research activities. These facilities enable students to gain practical exposure to contemporary industrial practices and modern research methodologies in Pharmaceutical Sciences.
0019: The department is supported by experienced and committed faculty members who play a pivotal role in strengthening students’ technical knowledge, professional skills, and research aptitude, thereby preparing them for successful careers in industry and research organizations.
0020: A key highlight is strong focus on experiential and hands-on learning. Students actively participate in real-time research projects under the guidance of faculty members, which helps them develop critical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and practical competencies required to address emerging global healthcare challenges.

0017: Department of Biotechnology : Profile
0018: Biotechnology is a multidisciplinary field with immense potential for advancing human welfare, particularly in areas such as human and animal health, food and nutrition, agriculture, animal sciences, environmental science, and more. It has emerged as a key area of focus in science and technology, with the capability to significantly contribute to the economic growth of India and World.
0019: In the 21st century, the global vision for biotechnology emphasizes the transition of bio-based innovations “from Lab to Land and from Bench to Business”, ensuring that the benefits of biotechnological advancements reach society at large by making bio-based products more accessible and affordable.
0020: In alignment with this vision, the Department of Biotechnology was established in 2024, offering a B. Tech in Biotechnology. The department also offer two postgraduate programs: M.Sc. in Biotechnology, M.Sc. in Biochemistry, and Ph.D. in Biotechnology from the Academic Year 2025-2026.
0021: These programs focus on integrated approaches to critical areas such as human health, biopolymers, recombinant DNA technology, transgenic development, infection and immunity etc. A key highlight of the curriculum is the emphasis on hands-on learning, students engage directly with faculty on real-time research projects, equipping them with the practical skills required to address emerging global challenges.
